name: Scav
description: A desert-planet scavenger, a man in his thirties, weathered and quiet, who sings dusty spaghetti-western ballads.
build: A lean, rangy adult build of ordinary proportions: medium shoulders, a straight torso, arms and legs of ordinary length, standing upright with straight knees.
face: Sun-darkened brown skin, narrow grey eyes, straight dark brows, a hooked nose, a short dark-brown beard, and thin lips.
hair: Covered by a wide sand-coloured scarf wrapped round the head and neck, the face left open, a loose tail falling behind the character-right shoulder; round goggles with thick bronze rims and a bold rust-orange cloth patch on one strap pushed up on the forehead over the scarf.
outfit: Layers of wrapped rust-orange and sand cloth over the torso; a single big curved scrap-metal shoulder plate on the character-left shoulder, dull teal with bold rivets, strapped across the chest; a scrap-metal chest plate of the same teal; a wide brown leather belt with empty pouches; loose sand-coloured trousers wrapped at the shins; tall scuffed brown boots. Forearms wrapped in sand cloth ending at the wrist, both hands bare.
performance_style: Weight on the character-right leg, the character-left knee loose. Both arms hang at his sides, the character-right and character-left hands open, empty, fingers fully visible. Head level, a steady squint.
location: A wide desert of orange dunes under a hazy pale sky with two suns, seen from packed sand running to the bottom of the frame, a half-buried rusted starship hull on the horizon.
recognition_cues: a sand-coloured head scarf with round bronze-rimmed goggles on the forehead
a big dull-teal scrap-metal shoulder plate on the character-left shoulder
wrapped rust-orange and sand cloth layers
palette: scarf, trousers and arm wraps sand #C8AC80 / #8A7250 / #E6D2AC
cloth wraps and goggle patch rust-orange #B0542A / #6E3216 / #D87C4A
belt, pouches and boots brown leather #5A3A22 / #341F10 / #825A3A
avoid: the scarf drawn over the face

sing.intent: Western-ballad vocal loop: slow, the mic in the character-right hand rises to the mouth, the character-left hand opens out low at hip height, the head tips back on a long held note, then he returns to the easy stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so he unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief startle at a gust of sand: the head turns aside, the character-left forearm lifts before the face, then he lowers it. No opponent or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: turn the plated shoulder forward and raise both open forearms, then hold. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: trudge in with slow heavy steps, touch the goggles with the character-right hand, then settle into the stance with both hands open.
